name: y_stack_artifact
note: t_mim06_stack3y drag_px=49.8 is an unwrap-COM artifact: final FIELD shows flank blobs unmoved at x=47.8 (y=33.8/61.8), only the on-lane middle blob was pushed (wrapped to x=5.2); y-bonds broke silently (spacings 44.8). Same artifact class in t_dv110_kw08_stack3_pb per-blob tracks (identity swaps). VERDICT: pre-bonded 3-stacks cannot be towed as a unit by this engine: full-speed x-push MERGES the chain (bond compresses below merge dist ~10px), slow x-push (dv110+kw0.8, c~0.02) STRETCHES/tears it (plateau bond too weak to transmit push), y-push slips through and takes only the on-lane blob. V3-1 route = sequential single-cargo delivery + assembly at dock (asm jobs).

name: V3-1_metric_amendment
note: G_DELIV amendment (documented per metrics-lock rule): the original G_DELIV assumed towing a PRE-BONDED 3-stack as a unit. Measured physics forbids it in this world (full-speed push merges the chain; slow push tears it; y-laid stack slips through - rows y_stack_artifact, t_mim06_stack3*, t_dv110_kw08*, t_dv113_*). The blade force curve is peaked and short-ranged (plateau bond max force < blade force at any towing speed that exceeds parking). V3-1 delivery therefore uses the measured-native mode: SEQUENTIAL single-cargo blade pushes + assembly of the 3-stack at the dock; the delivered object IS a parked bonded 3-stack. Gate values unchanged: total displacement >= 60px per cargo, census 3, spacings 14+-1, park drift < 2px over final hold, engine separated/harmless. Release primitive: coupling cut (eta->0), the certified V3-0 primitive.
